ctx.x: Walter Page had the band, the Blue Devils. The first one to leave him was Hot Lips Page - no, the first one to leave was Jimmie Rushing, then Basie, then Hot Lips Page.
Basie was working in Bennie Moten's band?

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Jimmie only sang the blues for us once a night after the dance... So we take Billie. [INTERVIEWER] She was the first girl vocalist with your band?

ctx.x: the first one to leave the band, right? Jimmie, to go to Bennie Moten, and then he brought Basie in.
